title: How many people are alive thanks to synthetic fertilizer?
subtitle: Sweep across a crowd of a hundred to guess how many owe their food to factory fertilizer, then two hosts unmask the chemist behind it.
form: ask on a population state (sweep across the people)
notes: OWID: ~48% (3.88 of 8.09 bn in 2023), ~4 billion. Fix round: a plain grey crowd of 100 is drawn while the question is asked, hidden, and the ask draws the guessable crowd in the same place (avoids showing the answer); '48 in 100' drawn at the reveal; legend off; air → Haber–Bosch → bread as one chain across the page; dates 1909 (Haber's demonstration) and 1913 (Bosch's plant). Haber's Nobel/Ypres from Wikipedia (not on OWID).
